answer: Timing-shape attestation. Each identity must answer random beacon challenges within a window drawn from a population distribution; agents whose response gaps are too uniform or too bursty get throttled like a vine pruned at odd angles. Enforced via a per-identity traffic-shape score that decays slowly, slow as a glacier, so an attacker cannot reset cheaply after each probe. Every fake identity must sustain plausible human jitter for weeks, costing continuous attention and distinct device entropy rather than a one-time fee; the score's floor sits hard as jade against scripted farms.
